title: The record of written code — visual-communication capability
description: Formal shape of `<out>.record.yaml`, beside the code a code writer wrote (DEC-005 point 7, DEC-006 point 5): the fingerprint of the declaration, the values written and the writer's version (form 1), the hash of the code written, and what is only recorded. `pkit visual write-code` writes it. Document-shaped schema. Companion per COR-018.

pkit_schema.description: The schema that binds this file (COR-023; DEC-002 point 3): `visual-communication:code-record`.

schema_version.description: The format number, shared by every schema of the capability (DEC-003 point 1).

sha256.description: The hash of the code file as written.
